feature: The drop line stops counting at two
summary: Carry a text style or a colour over two selected layers and the app now says "both of them" instead of "all 2 of them". Three or more still says the number, because that is the part worth knowing.
setup: Photonz Probe or Photonz Dev, release Next. Nothing to switch on.

try.do: Draw two pieces of text on the canvas.
Select the first, then shift click the second.
Save a text style called Heading from the Text section, so a tile appears on the Library shelf.
Drag the Heading tile over one of the two selected pieces of text and hold it there.
Read the blue pill under the pointer: it should say "Sets both of them in Heading."
Add a third piece of text, select all three, and hold the tile over them again: the pill goes back to "Sets all 3 of them in Heading."
Select two shapes, hover the Fill swatch while dragging a colour onto it, and let the tooltip settle: it says "Paints Fill on both of them with this colour."

evaluate: Does "both of them" read like something a person would say, where "all 2 of them" did not?
Is "all 3 of them" still the right shape from three up, or would you rather see a number at two as well?
The pill sits under the pointer and the panel a few inches away still says "2 layers" and "1 of them". Do those two ways of counting clash?
Dropping a text style shows a sentence in a pill. Dropping a colour on a swatch shows only a lit ring, with the sentence hidden in a tooltip. Should the colour drop speak up the same way?
rough: Screen Recording is granted for the probe, so the picture above is a real capture of the window, not an offscreen render.

Only the two drop sentences and the Effects list eye now share the wording. About eighteen other places in the panel still say "all 2 of them" in their tooltips and notes: Parts, Effects, the colour panel, the component panel, and the saved style warnings. Filed as a follow-up to sweep them with the same helper.

The colour drop sentence is never drawn on screen. It is a tooltip and a screen reader value only, so it has no photograph here and it is verified by unit tests instead. Filed as a follow-up, because the text style drop shows its sentence in a pill and the colour drop showing nothing is a difference nobody chose.
effects-remembered-walk fails on main, before and after this change, at step 24. Filed separately; it is not caused by this work.
